name: build bundle --next refusal, override and impacted-FBS skip
purpose: 0.30.0 PR 8 (spec section 4 bundle row, section 11.7 US-17702). `rcf build bundle --next` is tightened against the detection-model freeze record: without a freeze record the verb refuses with exit 4 naming `rcf define readiness`; `--override "<reason>"` writes `freeze.override { reason, by, at }` through saveFreezeRecord and proceeds; on a non-empty delta against the current tree, the next-item compute skips re-execute FBS impacted by the delta with the reason text in a line and hands out the next unimpacted FBS; when every actionable FBS is impacted and no override is given the verb refuses with exit 4 with the same message. On a frozen tree with an empty delta the verb's 0.29.0 shape is unchanged (AC-17702-5).
responsibilities: refusal: on `bundle --next` with no freeze record, exit 4 with a usage line naming `rcf define readiness` (and `--override "<reason>"` as the override channel); the next-item compute does not run.

override: `--override "<reason>"` on `bundle --next` writes `freeze.override { reason, by, at }` through saveFreezeRecord before the next-item compute runs; `--override` without a non-empty reason is a usage refusal (exit 2); when a freeze record exists the override is still written and the override reason is named in the output.

skip: on a non-empty delta against the current tree hash, next-item selection filters re-execute FBS impacted by the delta out of the actionable queue with a stderr line naming each skipped FBS and the reason; the next unimpacted actionable FBS is handed out.
all-impacted refusal: when every actionable FBS is impacted by the delta and no override is given, the verb refuses with exit 4 and the same message pointing at `--override "<reason>"`.
unchanged on empty delta: on a frozen tree with an empty delta the verb's output and exit code are byte-for-byte unchanged from 0.29.0 (AC-17702-5).

override.by identity (PR 9, AC-17702-6): freeze.override.by is resolved by `resolveOverrideBy({projectRoot})` with the preference order `git config user.email` -> `GITHUB_ACTOR` -> `USER` -> `USERNAME` -> literal `operator`. Each failing arm falls through silently to the next; the write path cannot blow up on a stripped-down container.
internalStructure: The next-item path in `src/cli/build.js` grows a pre-emit guard (`enforceBundleNextFreezeGate`) that loads the freeze record and the computed delta via loadFreezeRecord and computeDelta, applies the `--override` write (if given) before the next-item compute, and emits a refusal when the record is absent and no override is given. The impacted-FBS skip extends `selectNext` to accept an `impactedFbsIds` set and skip them with a stderr reason; the all-impacted case falls through to a refusal rather than an empty envelope. `freeze.override` records come through `saveFreezeRecord` so the existing schema and canonical-JSON contract are reused; a short writer `applyOverrideToFreezeRecord` writes `freeze.override` on the live freeze record (creating a minimal record stamped with `frozenAt=now`, `treeHash=currentTreeHash`, `docHashes=whole-tree`, `briefStatements=0` when none exists).

interfaces.name: enforceBundleNextFreezeGate
interfaces.description: `moduleApi` (`src/cli/build.js`). Signature: ({ tree, projectRoot, overrideReason, by }) -> { ok: boolean, exitCode?: 2|4, message?: string, impactedFbsIds?: Set<string>, override?: { reason, by, at } }. Reads the freeze record and `computeDelta(tree, { freeze })`, applies the override write when `overrideReason` is set, and either returns ok with the impacted-FBS set, or a refusal with exit 4 and the usage message. authoredAt: D3.

interfaces.name: applyOverrideToFreezeRecord
interfaces.description: `moduleApi` (`src/define/freeze-record.js`). Signature: ({ projectRoot, reason, by, at }) -> { filePath }. Loads or creates a freeze record, sets its override to { reason, by, at }, writes through saveFreezeRecord. authoredAt: D3.

interfaces.name: selectNext
interfaces.description: `moduleApi` (`src/build/queue.js`). Extended to accept an optional `{ impactedFbsIds, io }` parameter: when supplied, re-execute FBS whose id is in `impactedFbsIds` are skipped with a stderr line naming the FBS and the reason, and the next unimpacted FBS is returned; when every actionable FBS is impacted, returns `null` and the caller treats that as the all-impacted refusal.

interfaces.name: resolveOverrideBy
interfaces.description: `moduleApi` (`src/cli/build.js`). Signature: ({ projectRoot }) -> Promise<string>. Resolves the identity for `freeze.override.by` under the R11 preference order (git config user.email, GITHUB_ACTOR, USER, USERNAME, operator). Pure of side effects beyond one bounded `git config --get user.email`. authoredAt: D3.

notes: Spec amendment 2026-10-03 R9 does not alter this TAC: delta semantics are unchanged, the litmus hash is a readiness concern only. `freeze.override` writes do not shift `tree.currentTreeHash` or `tree.litmusHash` (the probes ledger is excluded from the litmus hash by R9; the override lives in the freeze record, not in a tree document). The brief named this TAC as `tac-4125*.json`; the file name follows the dash-prefixed naming convention of neighbouring TACs.
